body: -- Founder: 'can we please use the full promptoverse thread from start to end as a counter argument to LLMs are not good at ops? as a blog post'. Uses this session's real prompt-o-verse arc as evidence: the mashup-discovery lexical-matching failure and rebuild, the 3-attempt live-reload root-cause hunt (including two real misdiagnoses and a self-caught forgot-to-deploy mistake, told honestly not softened), the variants feature design correction caught mid-build, and the double-encrypted GCS backup system built as a parallel thread. Live at https://okemily.com/blog/a-counterexample-to-llms-cant-do-ops/.
title: Published blog post: 'A Counterexample To LLMs Can't Do Ops'
